reason: Official German wage tax tables that give net pay directly for a stated gross wage DO NOT EXIST and cannot be obtained for tax year 2026, because they were abolished. Established from the primary instrument, not inferred. The Bundesministerium der Finanzen publishes only Programmablaeufe (machine-calculation programmes) for wage tax, plus calculators and informational modules. The 2026 BMF navigation, which I read, lists exactly four wage-tax sections and no table: 'FAKTORVERFAHREN', 'BERECHNUNG DER LOHNSTEUER', 'ERMITTLUNG DES ZU VERSTEUERNDEN JAHRESBETRAGS' and 'ARBEITSLOHNGRENZEN'. Under BERECHNUNG DER LOHNSTEUER the only years offered are calculators (2026, 2025, 2024 Dezember, 2024 bis November, 2023 ab Juli, 2023 bis Juni, 2022, 2021), and the 2026 entry is titled 'Lohn- und Einkommensteuerrechner: Eingabeformular 2026 Lohnsteuer'. Corroborated by a secondary publisher of German wage tax tables, which I fetched and read and which states the position directly: 'Fuer den Lohnsteuerabzug gab es bis 2003 amtliche Lohnsteuertabellen von der Finanzverwaltung. Es werden nur noch Programmablaeufe zur Berechnung der Lohnsteuer veroeffentlicht. Mit den Lohnsteuerrechnern koennen Sie die Lohnsteuer stufenlos berechnen. Dennoch werden weiterhin (nicht amtliche) Lohnsteuertabellen veroeffentlicht, weil sie uebersichtlich sind und ohne maschinelle Berechnung einfach ablesbar sind.' CONSEQUENCE FOR THIS CORPUS: the ideal German evidence tier, an official tax authority publishing a net-pay table, is permanently unavailable. A net figure can only be produced by running the authority's own calculator or by implementing its Programmablaufplan, which is what DE/020_net_monthly_income.json and DE/020b_net_monthly_income_academics.json do.
what_blocked_it: The instrument does not exist. Two practical obstacles were also hit and are recorded so nobody wastes time on them again. First, the BMF Programmablaufplan Anlage 2 for 2026 is distributed only as a PDF, and it could not be read as text by the tooling available, so the tax-deduction step for Vorsorgeaufwendungen could not be lifted verbatim from it; the fetch returned raw PDF bytes. The official calculator was therefore used instead, which is the better primary route anyway. Second, gesetze-im-internet.de serves a section-numbered page for EStG Section 11 whose content is the income-and-expense timing rules, NOT the wage-tax Vorsorgepauschale provision, so it could not be used to confirm the exact tax-deduction formula; this is why the derived figure in DE/020 relies on the calculator's own output for the Lohnsteuer component rather than on a reimplementation.
recommended_handling: For Germany, always derive net by running the official BMF Lohn- und Einkommensteuerrechner at the gross figure the corpus holds, entering Steuerklasse I, 0 Kinderfreibetraege, no church tax and the BMG average Zusatzbeitrag of 2.9 per cent, and add statutory employee social contributions from the SVBezGrV ceilings. Never cite a commercial 'Lohnsteuertabelle 2026' as if it were official, even though several such tables reproduce the official PAP closely; one of them, cross-checked by me against the official calculator, was systematically out by 0.6 to 2.7 per cent of the tax, which is precisely the risk of relying on a non-official table. Note also that the Solidaritaetszuschlag is fully abolished for 2026: the official calculator returns EUR 0.00 for it at every income tested, and the BMF 2026 Lohnsteuer overview contains no solidarity-surcharge entries at all.
raw_extract: BMF calculator page, navigation read verbatim: 'Berechnungen zur Lohnsteuer / FAKTORVERFAHREN 2026 2025 2024 2023 (ab Juli) 2023 (bis Juni) 2022 2021 / BERECHNUNG DER LOHNSTEUER 2026 2025 2024 (Dezember) 2024 (bis November) 2023 (ab Juli) 2023 (bis Juni) 2022 2021 / ERMITTLUNG DES ZU VERSTEUERNDEN JAHRESBETRAGS 2026 2025 2024 2023 2022 2021 / ARBEITSLOHNGRENZEN 2026 2025 2024 2023'. BMF calculator, explanatory text read verbatim: 'Das Bundesministerium der Finanzen (BMF) erstellt im Einvernehmen mit den obersten Finanzbehoerden der Laender einen Programmablaufplan fuer die maschinelle Berechnung der Lohnsteuer. Der Programmablaufplan ist die Grundlage fuer die Berechnung der Lohnsteuer, des Solidaritaetszuschlags und der Bemessungsgrundlage fuer die Kirchensteuer.' Calculator result page, read verbatim at both corpus gross inputs: 'Die Lohnsteuer betraegt: ... Der Solidaritaetszuschlag betraegt: 0,00 Euro. Die Kirchensteuer betraegt: 0,00 Euro.'

field_mapping.net_monthly_income: de.career.net_monthly_income - no published official table exists; see DE/020_net_monthly_income.json for the calculator-derived value

notes: Recorded separately from the derived figure so that the evidence grade is explicit. The corpus should never describe the German net as 'the published official figure', because no such published figure exists; the honest description is 'derived from the Federal Ministry of Finance's official 2026 wage tax calculator plus the 2026 statutory contribution rates'. This is the single most important methodological note for Germany in this corpus, because German net-pay calculators are widely syndicated and routinely presented as authoritative when they are not.
evidence_limitations: A negative finding about the existence of an instrument, established as of 2026-10-05. It does not say that no official German net figure can ever be obtained - it says one cannot be obtained as a PUBLISHED TABLE, and must be produced by running the official calculator. The attempted-sources list includes two entries I could not read (the BMF Anlage 2 PDF, which returned binary, and the EStG Section 11 page, whose content did not match the expected provision); both are recorded rather than omitted.
